approved_scope.title: Fix 266
acceptance_criteria: During a git merge or rebase (MERGE_HEAD, REBASE_HEAD or a rebase in progress), chough next and chough status print a line naming it and saying to finish or abort it first, and chough doctor reports a git_operation finding with no fix that names it and any unmerged paths. While a path under .chough/ is unmerged, a command that writes Chough's records refuses as refused:unmerged, naming the paths and saying to finish or abort the merge or rebase first, with every file unchanged; reads still work. With no merge or rebase in progress nothing changes.
